basic_details.job_title: IIIT Ranchi Field Investigator/ Project Staff Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Sciences and Humanities & Management at the Indian Institute of Information Technology (IIIT) Ranchi, an Institute of National Importance under an Act of Parliament, has invited applications from Indian citizens for 1 temporary Field Investigator/Project Staff post. The post is in the research project "Custom against Law: Child Marriage in Tribal Communities of Jharkhand", sponsored by Dr. Ram Dayal Munda Tribal Welfare Research Institute (TRI), Government of Jharkhand. The fellowship is Rs. 30,000/- per month for an initial period of 5 months. The essential qualification is

how_to_apply: Prepare the application in the prescribed format. The format, headed "Application for the Post of Project Assistant", is on page 2 of the notice.
Attach self-attested copies of all supporting documents. Combine the application and documents as a single PDF file.
Email the PDF to the Principal Investigator, Dr. Rohit Kandulna, at [email protected].
Write the email subject as "Application for Field Investigator/ Project Staff under TRI sponsored project".
Also fill out the Google Form that the notice asks applicants to complete (see the Application Form link below).
The last date of receipt of applications is 25 November 2026.
Self-attested copies of all supporting documents, submitted with the application as a single PDF file.
Proof of category (GEN/SC/ST/OBC), to be attached as the form directs.
Publication/patent details with proof, on a separate sheet.
Details of two referees (name, designation, affiliation, email ID, contact number).
Original age proof, certificates, degrees, mark sheets and other testimonials, to be presented at the time of interview and joining (if selected).

The form also asks for a photograph, educational qualifications (10th, 12th, B.A., M.A. and any other), the B.A. dissertation title, the M.A. project title, a declaration and the applicant's signature.
important_instructions: No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview and/or joining the position. The Institute reserves the right to cancel the recruitment without assigning any reason. Ineligible candidates will not be allowed. Original documents must be presented at the time of interview and joining (if selected) for verification.

content_sections.heading: About IIIT Ranchi
content_sections.text: The Indian Institute of Information Technology Ranchi is an Institute of National Importance under an Act of Parliament, located in Ranchi, Jharkhand. The advertised project will be implemented in its Department of Sciences and Humanities & Management. The Principal Investigator and Co-Principal Investigator are Dr. Rohit Kandulna and Dr. Noopur, Assistant Professors at the Institute.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian citizens may apply. The notice gives one post, Field Investigator/ Project Staff, with the following conditions. The desirable qualification also covers familiarity with relevant socio-cultural practices, customary laws, and the legal framework concerning the prevention of child marriage. Age limit: should not exceed 35 years as of last date of application. Age relaxations will be provided as per Govt. norms and to the candidates with relevant experiences. The notice does not list the relaxation by category. Ineligible candidates will not be allowed, so applicants should check eligibility before applying. For the discipline-specific eligibility, see the official notification.

rows.essential_qualification: Master's degree in Social Sciences, Geography, Anthropology, or Sociology, with a minimum of 60% marks or 6.0 CPI (on a 10-point scale) at the Master's degree level.
rows.desirable: Demonstrated knowledge and practical, hands-on experience in the field of child marriage, particularly in tribal communities of Jharkhand.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The fellowship is Rs. 30,000/- per month. The remuneration is disbursed upon successful completion of the assigned project-related activities and fulfilment of the prescribed responsibilities, in accordance with the terms and conditions stipulated by TRI, Government of Jharkhand. The initial appointment is for a period of 05 (five) months. It may be extended further, subject to the candidate's performance and availability of funds under the project, or terminated earlier, if required. The assignment is purely temporary in nature.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIIT Ranchi Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The last date of receipt of applications is 25 November 2026. Self-attested copies of all supporting documents, submitted with the application as a single PDF file. Proof of category (GEN/SC/ST/OBC), to be attached as the form directs. Publication/patent details with proof, on a separate sheet. Details of two referees (name, designation, affiliation, email ID, contact number). Original age proof, certificates, degrees, mark sheets and other testimonials, to be presented at the time of interview and joining (if selected). The form also asks for a photograph, educational qualifications (10th, 12th, B.A., M.A. and any other), the B.A. dissertation title, the M.A. project title, a declaration and the applicant's signature.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisting will be carried out as per the decision of the selection committee. Shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview. The notice gives no interview date and does not describe the interview in detail. It asks candidates to refer to the Institute website for updates, if any.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IIIT Ranchi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy, for the post of Field Investigator/ Project Staff.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date of receipt of applications is 25 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: A Master's degree in Social Sciences, Geography, Anthropology, or Sociology, with a minimum of 60% marks or 6.0 CPI (on a 10-point scale) at the Master's degree level.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age should not exceed 35 years as of last date of application. Age relaxations are provided as per Govt. norms and to candidates with relevant experiences.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary?
faq.answer: The fellowship is Rs. 30,000/- per month. It is disbursed upon successful completion of the assigned project-related activities and fulfilment of the prescribed responsibilities.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Email the application in the prescribed format, with self-attested copies of all supporting documents as a single PDF, to [email protected]. Use the subject "Application for Field Investigator/ Project Staff under TRI sponsored project", and also fill out the Google Form.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Shortlisting is done as per the decision of the selection committee. Shortlisted candidates will be called for interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The assignment is purely temporary. The initial appointment is for 5 months, which may be extended subject to performance and availability of project funds, or terminated earlier.

faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview and/or joining the position.
